name: @rivetplane/cli-workspace
description: Public source and release workspace for the Rivetplane CLI

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/shared build && bun run --cwd packages/client build
scripts.clean: bun run --cwd packages/shared clean && bun run --cwd packages/client clean
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared build && bun run --cwd packages/client typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/shared test && bun run --cwd packages/client test
